name: stream-radio
description: Play any YouTube (or other mpv-supported) stream's audio from Claude Code with /stream <url>, and show what is playing in the prompt footer, with a side panel to pick songs from a playlist.

defaultUrl.title: Default stream
defaultUrl.description: What a bare /stream plays. Empty: /stream needs a URL.

player.title: Player command
player.description: The mpv executable. YouTube also needs yt-dlp on the PATH.

androidClient.title: Always use the android client
androidClient.description: Play with yt-dlp's android client from the start, instead of only after the default one fails. Skips the failed first try for content YouTube refuses (403); AAC, more bandwidth.

toggleOnly.title: Footer button toggles play/pause
toggleOnly.description: Clicking the song in the footer toggles play and pause at once, instead of opening the panel (/stream panel still opens it).
